verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a dedicated Developer Sandbox, reached through a separate developer sign-up. It replicates core v2 API functionality using test funds and simulated activity, supports mocked flows, transfers and integration tests, and accepts testnet/devnet faucet assets plus Dashboard funding, so testing stays isolated from production. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation that the sandbox goes beyond 'core v2' (for example FIX/WebSocket parity) and beyond the limit of Dashboard funding to USD and Paxos-issued stablecoins.
